problem: Cross-browser assurance remained red after the real website CLS defects were fixed because a prior document retry net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET was retained even though the same final document loaded successfully.
root_cause: The runner accumulated requestfailed events across navigation retries but did not reconcile document failures against the final successful URL/status.
decision: Reuse the existing settled-navigation semantics: when the final document is HTTP-successful, suppress only transient failed document attempts for that same final pathname; preserve script/stylesheet failures and unrelated document failures.
prevention: Track finalUrl after successful settled navigation.
Filter only transient document retry failures matching the final successful pathname.
Never suppress script or stylesheet failures.
Never suppress failed document requests when the final response is not successful.
evidence: GitHub run 37208375964 attempt 2: homepage final render succeeded but document:/:net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET remained
